jobs.title: Director, Strategic Business Operations (BizOps)
jobs.description:
Substack is building a new economic engine for culture, giving the brightest, most interesting, and most creative people on the internet the power of their own publishing platform. Substack empowers independent writers, artists, videographers, podcasters, and creators of all types to create, share, and make a living off their work through subscriptions, while offering them creative freedom, ownership, and a direct connection to their audiences.

We are looking for an exceptional, high-leverage Business Operations leader to serve as a strategic co-pilot to our CEO and CFO.

This is not a pure strategy seat, a deck-building role, or traditional corporate management. We are looking for an "athlete": someone with elite analytical rigor, a first-principles mindset, and the hands-on drive to build data pipelines, run complex business analyses, and personally execute high-stakes initiatives across the company.

You will sit at the center of Substack’s business—identifying bottlenecks, uncovering growth drivers, optimizing creator and reader economics, and building the operating infrastructure that scales our business.

At Substack, you’ll work directly alongside our founders and executive leadership team to shape the future of independent publishing and media. You’ll have a front-row seat—and a hands-on steering wheel—in scaling the business.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Strategic & Operational Execution: Uncover, prioritize, and drive the business’s highest-impact initiatives across product, growth, pricing, and creator economics.

 - Data-Driven Business Insights: Get hands-on keyboard with our data. Perform deep-dive analyses on core metrics (e.g., creator churn, reader LTV, network monetization, conversion funnels) to guide product and monetization decisions.

 - External & Market Intelligence: Conduct rigorous competitive analysis, market mapping, and strategic positioning to evaluate new opportunities, industry shifts, and expansion vectors.

 - Executive Decision Support: Partner directly with the CEO and CFO to translate complex operational data into clear, actionable executive decisions and board-level strategy.

 - Management Infrastructure: Design and run our business cadence—KPI tracking, operational reviews, cross-functional alignment, and objective-setting—keeping the executive team in sync and operating with discipline.

 - Team Building & Leadership: Lead and mentor a lean team of operators as Substack scales, while remaining willing and eager to do the frontline analytical work yourself.




ABOUT YOU

 - Elite Foundation: 5–10 years of total work experience, including foundational years at a top-tier management consulting firm or investment bank, followed by high-impact BizOps/Strategy experience at a fast-growing tech company. Top-tier undergraduate or MBA (HBS, Stanford, Wharton, etc.) preferred.

 - Hands-on Analytics: Comfortable with quantitative modeling and data manipulation.  Ideally you don’t ask a team to pull numbers for you—you dig into the database yourself.

 - First-Principles Problem Solver: You break down complex, messy problems into clear hypotheses and actionable frameworks before writing code or pulling data.

 - Bias for Action & Execution: You don't stop at giving recommendations or making slides. You can help drive implementation end-to-end in partnership with other leaders.

 - Low Ego, High Ownership: You act like an owner. You care deeply about solving the right problems for creators and readers, regardless of whether a task falls neatly into your job description.

 - Executive-Level Communication: Concise, direct, and persuasive—able to influence senior executives, engineers, and creative partners alike without relying on corporate jargon.

Substack’s compensation package includes a market-competitive salary, equity for all full-time roles, and exceptional benefits. Our cash compensation salary range for this role is $200,000 - $300,000. Multiple factors, including candidate experience and expertise, determine final offer amounts and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Substack is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or transgender status), age, national origin, veteran or disability status. We’re seeking people passionate about enabling independent expression and building a better business model for creators. If you want to see what media, communities, and content can become when unmoored from advertising models, and you have the skills and experience to contribute, we’d love to meet you.

Please see our Privacy Notice for details regarding Substack's collection and use of personal information relating to the application and recruitment process by clicking here https://docs.google.com/document/d/1UjmY1acxnd27iIde83PxR7XdecR29aIyfkkmEOwAMGY/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.a0wuzmt3mjmm.

jobs.title: Sales Manager, Brand Partnerships
jobs.description:
Substack is building a new economic engine for culture, giving the brightest, most interesting, and most creative people on the internet the power of their own publishing platform. Substack empowers independent writers, artists, videographers, podcasters, and creators of all types to create, share, and make a living off their work through subscriptions, while offering them creative freedom, ownership, and a direct connection to their audiences.

The Brand Partnerships team at Substack is building our sponsorships business from the ground up. The Sales Manager will help lead that revenue engine. Brands want to reach the audiences that trust Substack publishers, and your job is to turn that demand into a repeatable sales motion, from the first agency meeting through signed insertion orders and renewals. This is a founding role on a small team, so the playbook is yours to write.




RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Build sponsorships revenue number, and the pipeline, forecast, and pacing behind it

 - Sell directly to senior brand and agency decision-makers, leading the largest and most strategic deals from prospecting through close

 - Contribute to building the sales infrastructure a new business needs: territory and account coverage, pricing and packaging discipline, CRM hygiene, and a deal process that holds up as volume grows

 - Translate Substack's story into a pitch that lands with CMOs and media planners, working with creative strategy to shape proposals that feel native to the platform

 - Work closely with publishers and their teams to make sure sold campaigns are ones they actually want to run

 - Bring market signal back into the company, shaping product, pricing, and positioning based on what you hear in rooms with buyers

 - Represent Substack at industry events and in key agency relationships, opening doors for the whole team


ABOUT YOU:

 - 10+ years in media or advertising sales, with meaningful time selling premium, direct-sold sponsorships at a publisher, platform, or media company

 - A track record of closing seven-figure deals with brands and holding company agencies, and relationships you can activate from day one

 - Comfort operating without a playbook: you've sold something new to market before, or built a sales function inside an early-stage business

 - Fluency in how brands buy creator and content-led media, including measurement expectations, agency dynamics, and where budgets are moving

 - Strong instincts for pricing and packaging, and the discipline to protect them under pressure to close

 - Exceptional communication skills; you can pitch a CMO, coach a team member, and help build products that land in market

 - Genuine belief in independent publishing and what Substack is building; bonus if you're a Substack reader or writer yourself

jobs.title: Head of People
jobs.description:
Substack is building a new economic engine for culture, giving the brightest, most interesting, and most creative people on the internet the power of their own publishing platform. Substack empowers independent writers, artists, videographers, podcasters, and creators of all types to create, share, and make a living off their work through subscriptions, while offering them creative freedom, ownership, and a direct connection to their audiences.

About the Role
Substack is looking for a Head of People to build and scale our People function at a pivotal stage of growth. You'll own the strategy, systems, and programs that shape how we hire, develop, reward, and support our team. That spans benefits, compensation, leveling, review and promotion cycles, learning and development, employee experience, and recruiting.

This role is both strategic and hands-on. You'll build the infrastructure, processes, and leadership practices that let us grow without losing the speed and ambition that define Substack. You'll advise company leadership on org design, talent strategy, and workforce planning, and you'll also get into the day-to-day: improving how things work and supporting employees and managers directly.

You're a self-starter who sets a high bar and pushes the team to meet it. You're resourceful, equally comfortable getting hands on and delegating to others. You've seen what excellent People organizations look like at strong companies, and you know how to adapt those practices to a company that's ready to mature and evolve its practices.

Responsibilities:

 - Partner with leadership to develop and execute a people strategy that supports Substack's mission, values, and business goals

 - Lead and scale the People function across recruiting, onboarding, compensation, benefits, employee experience, performance management, and talent development

 - Own our compensation, benefits, and leveling frameworks, and run the feedback, review, and promotion cycles

 - Build and run training, learning and development, and leadership coaching programs

 - Shape the employee experience, including office culture, people surveys, orientation, and onboarding

 - Lead recruiting strategy and make sure we hire exceptional people

 - Advise leadership on organizational design, workforce planning, and succession planning

 - Build and continuously improve the people systems, policies, and programs that help employees do their best work

 - Coach managers and leaders on performance, team effectiveness, and organizational challenges

 - Oversee employee relations and ensure issues are resolved thoughtfully and consistently

 - Use people analytics, reporting, and workforce insights to guide decisions

 - Ensure compliance with applicable employment laws and regulations

 - Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing People team



About You:

 - 8+ years of progressive experience in People or HR, with multi-functional expertise and leadership across:
   
   - Benefits, compensation, leveling, and feedback, promotion, and review cycles
   
   - Training, L&D, and leadership coaching
   
   - Employee experience, including office culture, people surveys, orientation, and onboarding
   
   - Recruiting

 - Startup or growth-stage experience (required)

 - A track record of excellence and best practices from strong, well-regarded companies

 - A self-starter who sets the pace and pushes the team

 - Resourceful: hands on and delegating to others

 - Range: demonstrated understanding, empathy, and familiarity with multiple company building disciplines (e.g., engineering, product, business, etc.) is a plus.

 - Proven ability to influence and advise executive leadership, with excellent communication and coaching skills

 - Strong analytical skills and comfort using data to inform People decisions

 - Nice to have: experience building a People team from scratch; knowledge of employment law and compliance across the regions we hire in
